title: A Yin–Yang Framework for Understanding Regional Cultural Dynamics: Insights from the Three Kingdoms of China

contributions.purpose: 把阴阳框架从跨国管理扩展为中国国内区域文化分析的反本质主义方法论
contributions.mechanism: 以阴阳(动态平衡/历史偶然/对立互补共存)为分析透镜,替代Hofstede式静态二分类型
contributions.evaluation: 定性/概念推进(非实证检验):将区域特征重构为历史偶然的平衡而非固定属性
contributions.domain: 文化地理/跨文化方法论
contributions.source_quote: it develops Yin–Yang as a methodological safeguard against essentialist cultural typologies by conceptualizing regional traits as historically contingent balances rather than fixed attributes

contributions.purpose: 以三国宏观区(魏蜀吴)作为启发式案例操作化该视角
contributions.mechanism: 整合历史政治、方言学(方言计量)、考古与交通网络三角证据描述开放-巩固振荡
contributions.evaluation: 定性:魏(扩张-收缩大振荡)、蜀(持续中的创新爆发)、吴(内修-海外开放共生),提供可迁移模型
contributions.source_quote: it demonstrates how a heuristic case (the Three Kingdoms macro-regions) can operationalize this lens in cultural geography, offering a transferable model for studying other internally differentiated world regions

self_declared_provenance.quote: This paper contributes to theory by extending the Yin–Yang framework from its common use in cross-national management studies to the analysis of intra-national regional cultural dynamics.
